en.headline: Over 11,000 apply for taxi and ride-hailing driver test
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said the response exceeded expectations, with the Transport Department arranging tests within two months for applicants.
body: More than 11,000 people have applied for the combined written test for taxi and ride-hailing vehicle drivers since applications opened in early August, Transport and Logistics Secretary Mable Chan said on Monday.

Speaking on a radio programme, Chan described the number as exceeding government expectations. The Transport Department has so far arranged four examination sessions and aims to schedule tests for applicants within two months at the latest.

Hong Kong has capped ride-hailing vehicle permits at 10,000 under new regulations. Drivers without a full taxi licence must pass the combined test and complete a pre-service course before applying for a ride-hailing vehicle driving permit.
Chan also noted that more than 20 organisations had collected application forms for ride-hailing platform licences after a briefing session, and urged interested parties to submit proposals promptly.

zh.headline: 的士及網約車綜合筆試逾1.1萬人報考
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示報考人數超符預期，運輸署會在最多兩個月內為申請人安排考試。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶星期一表示，自8月初接受報名以來，已有逾1.1萬人申請報考的士及網約車綜合筆試，人數超符預期。
陳美寶在電台節目指出，運輸署至今已安排4場考試，並承諾為申請人在最多兩個月內安排考試。
根據新的規管制度，網約車車輛許可證上限為1萬個。沒有的士正式駕駛執照的司機，須通過綜合筆試及完成職前課程，才可申請網約車車輛駕駛許可證。
陳美寶又指，運輸署早前舉辦簡介會後，已有逾20個單位索取網約車平台牌照申請表格，她呼籲有意者盡早提交建議書。
